diagnostic_evidence.quote: It is clear that $G[f](x)$ is Hermitian for each $x$.

issues.failure_explanation: The displayed G has top-right -φ2 and bottom-left +conj(φ2), so it is not Hermitian unless φ2=0; the proof later uses the matrix with +φ2 in the top-right. With the stated minus sign, the claimed quadratic-form identity fails. For example, with n=1, f(x)=sin(x)q, and y=1+q, T_1=0 but the stated RHS is nonzero. The check/hat eigenvalue formulas also correspond to the plus-sign matrix.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Change G[f](x) to [[φ1(f)(x), φ2(f)(x)],[conj(φ2(f)(x)), φ1(f)(-x)]] (or flip both off-diagonal signs consistently) and update subsequent references.
issues.overall_effect: The main spectral identity and all eigenvalue bounds/check-hat formulas depending on it are unreliable as stated.
issues.title: Sign error in G[f] makes the quaternion Toeplitz quadratic-form identity false
issues.why_classification: The defect is a single forced sign correction that restores the intended Hermitian matrix and preserves the stated spectral theory and downstream claims.

issues.failure_explanation: For even n=2k, Strang's first column uses t_0,...,t_{k-1} and sets the k-th entry to 0, so the circulant symbol is the partial sum up to k-1. The lemma instead uses m=floor(n/2)=k, including η(k). Thus the exact equality in (i) is false for even n; e.g. n=4 with t1=1 and t2=10 gives different eigenvalue sets.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use the partial sum f_{\lfloor(n-1)/2\rfloor} (i.e. n/2-1 for even n) in the eigenvalue formula, while keeping the angle range s=0,...,\lfloor n/2\rfloor, and adjust the proof and limit argument accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: The exact eigenvalue characterization of c(T_n) is wrong for even n; proofs of limiting formulas and downstream convergence results that rely on it are not established as written.
issues.title: Strang circulant eigenvalue formula uses an extra coefficient for even n
issues.why_classification: The repair is a local index correction to the partial sum and does not change the method, rates, or advertised scope.

issues.failure_explanation: For the conjugated blocks c(\bar φ2(T_n)) and c(\bar φ1(T_n)), the eigenvalues are not \overline{φ2(f_m)(θ)} and \overline{φ1(f_m)(θ)}. The first is -\overline{φ2(f_m)(θ)} and the second is φ1(f_m)(-θ). This makes the derived 2x2 block [[φ1,-φ2],[\bar φ2,\bar φ1]] incorrect; the correct block is similar to the plus-sign G, not equal to the mixed-sign matrix used in the proof.

failure_location.quote: Their eigenvalues are given by $\phi_1(f_m) \left(\frac{2\pi s}{n}\right)$, $-\phi_2(f_m) \left(\frac{2\pi s}{n}\right)$, $\overline{\phi_2(f_m) \left(\frac{2\pi s}{n}\right)}$ and $\overline{\phi_1(f_m) \left(\frac{2\pi s}{n}\right)}$ ($s=0,1,...,n-1$) respectively,

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the eigenvalues of c(\bar φ2(T_n)) to -\overline{φ2(f_m)(θ)} and of c(\bar φ1(T_n)) to φ1(f_m)(-θ), then note the resulting block is similar to the corrected G[f_m](θ).
issues.overall_effect: The proof of the exact eigenvalue characterization of Strang's circulant preconditioner is invalid; the lemma and downstream spectral clustering are not established by this proof.
issues.title: Miscomputed eigenvalues of conjugated circulant blocks in Lemma 3.2 proof
issues.why_classification: The repair is a local sign/exponent correction in the diagonalization step and does not require a new global argument.
